header.title: Developer Roles
header.subtitle: I work across frontend, backend, and mobile product development, with a current focus on senior frontend engineering.

skills.title: Frontend Developer
skills.description: Build responsive, accessible interfaces and reusable components that help product teams deliver consistent user workflows.
highlights: Develop web applications with clear component boundaries and maintainable state.
Connect interfaces to APIs with validation and useful loading, empty, and error states.
Collaborate on frontend architecture, code quality, and shared UI patterns.

skills.title: Backend Developer
skills.description: Build API services with clear contracts, secure authentication, reliable persistence, and practical deployment workflows.
highlights: Design REST APIs and separate transport, application, and data concerns.
Work with authentication, validation, relational databases, and caching.
Document setup and release steps so services are easier to run and maintain.

skills.title: Mobile Developer
skills.description: Develop mobile product features across Flutter and Android, including platform integrations and production app workflows.
highlights: Build cross-platform interfaces and connect them to backend services.
Integrate authentication and device capabilities with platform-aware behavior.
Apply reusable architecture and localization to mobile product development.
